cases.conditions: Charge fractions from commercial biosimilar/in-house bevacizumab; no shelf-life PTM acceptance limit established.

cases.numbering: Original mature heavy-chain sequence numbering in the studies; not IMGT

cases.conditions: Commercial cetuximab from murine SP2/0 expression; glycan composition depends on production system.
cases.functional_effect: Pre-existing IgE to alpha-gal on Fab glycans was associated with cetuximab anaphylaxis. This does not generalize to every sequon or glycoform.
cases.evidence_status: Observed glycosylation with clinical glycan-specific hypersensitivity evidence
